Novel Study / Reading Circles Manager

Split a class into reading circle groups, rotate discussion roles fairly meeting after meeting, and keep every group's chapter checkpoint in one place.

1 · Project & Roster
0 names
2 · Reading Circle Groups

Re-splitting replaces the current groups with a fresh random split. Role fairness memory is kept per student, so it carries over even if you regroup.

3 · Reading Schedule Planner

Spread the book across your meeting days between now and a target end date, and get a per-meeting chapter target. Click a row to drop that date and checkpoint straight into "Log a Meeting" below.

Doesn't know about school holidays or early-release days — skim the generated dates before you print.

4 · Discussion Roles

Every group gets these roles, one per student, distinct within the group. Extra students beyond the role list are labeled "Group Member." Give each role a few starter prompts — they print on that student's role card.

5 · Log a Meeting

One word per line. Add a definition after a colon if you want one: austerity: extreme plainness.

Add a roster, split into groups, set up roles, then log a meeting to assign today's roles.
